This plot is very small, only 0.08 hectares, and I have to be careful with my money. I will spread manure from my animals on this land because it costs me nothing, but I will not buy chemical fertilizer for such a tiny piece when the cooperative sells it in big sacks that are too expensive for me. I saved sorghum seed from last year, so I do not need to buy improved seed, and I do not see pests or water for irrigation here. My family will do all the work ourselves.
